description: URL to Markdown — convert any public HTTPS URL to clean LLM-ready Markdown for $0.001 USDC per accepted read, settled via x402 on Base. Failed reads are never charged. Use this when an agent needs a web page's content as compact Markdown, for example to ground a research answer. Returns the converted Markdown up to max_chars. An unsigned call returns the live x402 PAYMENT-REQUIRED challenge and never auto-spends; retry only with a challenge-specific payment_signature. A free fixed-source preview is at GET /api/web/preview and agent onboarding at GET /api/web/skill.md. Unsigned calls are read-only and idempotent with no side effects; a supplied signature authorizes one paid, irreversible x402 settlement in USDC on Base. On error, returns a structured error. For example, fetch a documentation page before summarizing it.

max_chars.description: Maximum Markdown characters to return, 1000-50000. Default 12000.

payment_signature.description: Canonical x402 v2 PAYMENT-SIGNATURE bound to this exact URL to Markdown challenge.

name: url_to_markdown

outputSchema.description: Canonical REST response envelope, or a local/transport rejection. Upstream data remains in body and is defined by the live capability schema.

body.description: Unmodified upstream JSON, or bounded response text. Consult that capability's live schema.

charged.description: Present on local/transport failures; these do not establish an upstream charge.

ok.description: Whether the upstream HTTP status is 2xx; not settlement proof.

payment_required.description: Observed PAYMENT-REQUIRED header; a challenge does not prove payment.

payment_response.description: Observed PAYMENT-RESPONSE header. Assess it together with accepted delivery.

status_code.description: Observed upstream HTTP status, or null when no response was obtained.

title: Url To Markdown
